import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os

# Paths
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
OUTPUT_DIR = "./submission"
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "submission.csv")
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)

# Get column names from sample submission
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
id_col = sample_sub.columns[0]

# Create validation set BEFORE training (genuine hold-out)
X_text_train, X_val_text, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["comment_text"],
    train_df[target_cols].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df[target_cols].values.astype(int),
)

# Feature engineering - text only with optimized ngram and tfidf params
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000,
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    stop_words="english",
)
X_train_vectorized = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_text_train)
X_val_vectorized = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_vectorized = vectorizer.transform(test_df["comment_text"])

# Hyperparameter grid search - optimize C and ngram combinations
param_grid = {
    "clf__C": [0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0],
    "vectorizer__ngram_range": [(1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3)],
}

grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    OneVsRestClassifier(LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, random_state=42)),
    param_grid,
    cv=5,
    scoring="roc_auc",
    n_jobs=-1,
    verbose=1,
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_vectorized, y_train)

# Use best estimator
best_clf = grid_search.best_estimator_
val_probs = best_clf.predict_proba(X_val_vectorized)
val_auc_scores = []
for i in range(len(target_cols)):
    val_auc_scores.append(roc_auc_score(y_val.iloc[:, i], val_probs[:, i]))
mean_val_auc = np.mean(val_auc_scores)
print(f"Column-wise ROC AUC on hold-out validation set: {mean_val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_preds = best_clf.predict_proba(X_test_vectorized)

# Save to submission file in ./submission/ directory
os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_df[id_col].values})
for i in range(len(target_cols)):
    column_name = target_cols[i]
    submission[column_name] = test_preds[:, i].clip(0, 1)

submission.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print(f"Submission saved successfully to {SUBMISSION_FILE} with {len(submission)} rows")
